name: crewai_wrapper_demo
description: Adapts any tool in this hub into a CrewAI tool automatically, generating a Pydantic args_schema from the tool's metadata.json and calling its run_tool(). Wraps a single tool or the entire catalogue, and reports what CrewAI tool a given hub tool would produce.

tool_name.description: Folder name of the hub tool to inspect, e.g. 'jwt_decoder'

tools_dir.description: Path to the hub's tools directory
